bbc2.uk.title: Saving Lives at Sea - Paddleboard 999

bbc2.uk.description: In Southampton, the team comes to the aid of Ahmed and Rifat, a profoundly deaf couple whose dream home became a nightmare after a rogue builder abandoned the project. With three young children, no savings left and living on a building site, they need help to complete their home and make it work for their family's needs. Nick and the team call on the local community to transform both the house and the family's future. (Arts/crafts, Home improvement, House/garden, DIY) - 2026

bbc2.uk.title: This Is BBC TWO
bbc2.uk.description: Preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two. (Educational, Entertainment, News, Special) - 2008

bbc2.uk.title: Glorious Gardens From Above - Essex

bbc2.uk.title: Countryfile - Yr Wyddfa
bbc2.uk.description: How do you protect Britain's busiest mountain when more than 600,000 people visit each year? Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley head to Yr Wyddfa to meet the people caring for its landscape.

bbc2.uk.title: BBC News
bbc2.uk.description: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

bbc2.uk.title: Landward
bbc2.uk.description: Dougie visits Ardtornish Estate in Morvern to see rare Irish cattle return to Scotland after centuries. Rosie visits the Peterhead dairy farm that is finding new markets for their milk.

bbc2.uk.title: Weatherman Walking - Northern Nostalgia
bbc2.uk.description: Derek takes an icy dip in a glacial lake, then visits Portmeirion and Llangollen.

bbc2.uk.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
bbc2.uk.description: Matt Tebbutt serves up a riot of flavour with dishes from Bryn Williams, Julie Lin and Poppy O'Toole. Meanwhile, Rick Stein and the Hairy Bikers head out of the studio. (Anthology, Cookery) - 2026

bbc2.uk.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France - Bordeaux
bbc2.uk.description: Eva enjoys Bordeaux's world-famous wines and its fresh produce and masterful Bordelaise sauces. (Documentary, Cookery, Travel) - 2026

bbc2.uk.title: Natural World - Moose in the Glen
bbc2.uk.description: Multi-millionaire landowner Paul Lister wants to turn his 23,000 acre estate north of Inverness into Europe's first wilderness reserve. Reinstating the old Caledonian pine forests is the first of his plans. He then wants to release long lost animals, starting with moose and wild boar, and eventually predators such as brown bears, lynx and wolves. (Documentary, Animals, Anthology, Nature) - 2008

bbc2.uk.title: World Championship Artistic Gymnastics - Apparatus Finals
bbc2.uk.description: Coverage of the second part of the apparatus finals from Rotterdam, the Netherlands, featuring the men's vault, parallel bars and horizontal bars, and the women's balance beam and floor. (Gymnastics)

bbc2.uk.title: Flog It
bbc2.uk.description: The team are in Gloucester, where presenter Paul Martin and experts Phillip Serrell and Michael Baggott discover some rare gems among the antiques and collectibles brought to the valuation day at the city's magnificent cathedral.

bbc2.uk.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Compilations:The Battle of the Pop Stars
bbc2.uk.description: From the road trip archives, music legends Peter Andre, Martin Kemp and Sinitta swap the studio for the saleroom, vying to be top of the pops. But who will get the number one spot. (Art, Collectibles) - 2026

bbc2.uk.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve - Mongolia

bbc3.uk.title: Shrek Forever After (2010)

It's finally time for them to enjoy the fame and fortune that they've always known they deserved. (Comedy) - 2021

bbc3.uk.title: Krapopolis - Please Demeter

(Science fiction, Sitcom) - 2008

bbc3.uk.title: Extras - Chris Martin
bbc3.uk.description: The good news is Andy's show, `When the Whistle Blows', has received a Bafta nomination. The bad news is that this draws the attention of Chris Martin, lead singer of Coldplay, who wants to be in the show. Then at the awards ceremony, not only does the show not win, but Darren and Maggie both contrive to get Andy into trouble. (Comedy) - 2006

utv.uk.description: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf. - 2024

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Ealing Broadway to South Kensington
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo reaches the capital. In the Queen of the Suburbs, Ealing, he finds comedy at the home of British cinema and is transformed for the silver screen by expert hair and make-up. In Fulham, Michael heads underground to London's new super sewer, which is taking shape beneath the River Thames. In central London, he visits the London School of Economics and Political Science. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Piccadilly Circus to Gravesend
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo hits the West End to explore an exotic store, which was a favourite among Edwardian ladies. At Covent Garden's Royal Ballet School he hears how in 1909 a Russian ballet company took London by storm and how its prima ballerina inspired the school's founding choreographer. Leaving the capital from Charing Cross, Michael heads for Dartford in Kent, where he discovers the origins of netball and gymslips at the North Kent College. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - East Malling to Rye
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo travels from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In the orchards of East Malling, Kent, Michael discovers that the Edwardians' serious attitude towards cultivation bore fruit. Rootstock developed at the NIAB Centre for Fruit Research, established in 1913, is today responsible for much of world apple production. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 5
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey along the Cumbrian coast visiting Whitehaven, which from 1630 became the third most popular port in England. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Northern Ireland and Ireland Part 3
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Bangor, where the beautiful houses facing the sea are a sign of the renaissance that the city has experienced in recent years, thanks in part to its great cultural offer. (Documentary, Travel)

itv1anglia.uk.description: E10683 23/10/2026 Thea steals Kim's phone, while Liam seems to be hiding something and Kammy makes a declaration.

itv1anglia.uk.description: E11968 23/10/2026 Debbie rows with an old adversary before setting her sights on a new man, and Fiz confronts Ross for deliberately sabotaging her family's film night.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Beat the Chasers
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E1 Bradley Walsh hosts as contestants Daniel, Rebekah, Raymond, Samuel and Daniella face the six Chasers - the Sinnerman, the Beast, the Governess, the Menace, the Vixen and the Dark Destroyer, arguably the greatest quiz team in the world.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: S11 E212 23/10/2026 A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Godzilla vs Kong
itv1anglia.uk.description: Monster adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Millie Bobby Brown and Rebecca Hall. A team of scientists is recruited by a mysterious corporation to search for a power source in the "Hollow Earth", using Kong as their guide. But Godzilla sees Kong as a rival to his dominance of the surface world, and there can only be one alpha.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Casino Royale
itv1anglia.uk.description: James Bond spoof, starring David Niven, Peter Sellers and Ursula Andress. Agent 007, whose exploits on behalf of his country have resulted in a knighthood, is now enjoying his retirement to the full. But when "M" is killed, Bond is called back into active service to halt the threat of the cash-strapped SMERSH organisation.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 Yorkshire Dales (30min) James explores the culinary delights of his native Yorkshire, where he is joined by good friend and fellow chef Brian Turner. James cooks tea-smoked trout on the Coniston Estate and later brushes up his clay-pigeon shooting skills, while Brian is challenged to a spot of off-road driving.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E14 Avery Island James heads to Louisiana and Avery Island, a large salt mound that is the home of the chilli peppers used to make Tabasco sauce. He meets the family who farm the peppers, make the sauce and run the Tabasco company and is even granted access to the pepper fields to cook two amazing dishes.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E26 Alan is joined by Mark Benton, Elizabeth Carling and Bill Fellows, while florist Simon Lycett creates a new centrepiece for the barn using seasonal blooms.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News
itv1anglia.uk.description: E81 24/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E32 James cooks lamb and turbot for actor Richard Armitage, currently starring in ITV1 crime drama Winter. Plus, recipes from chefs Atul Kochhar, John Hooker and Mark Birchall.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E3 The Dinner Party Clodagh McKenna shares her strategy for throwing a perfect fuss-free dinner party, beginning with shortcut cacio e pepe cheese straws to welcome the guests. There is a quick and impressive French classic chicken fricassée for the main course, a make-ahead pistachio tiramisu for dessert and fresh mint tea to end the evening. Her blueprint includes a stunning table setting where the trick is keeping things simple.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: E78 24/10/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV Racing: Live from Cheltenham : 24/10/2026
itv1anglia.uk.description: Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of the first Saturday meeting of the jumps season from Cheltenham, plus the Futurity Stakes from Doncaster, and racing from Newbury. With analysis from Tom Scudamore and Mick Fitzgerald, reports by Alice Plunkett, Oli Bell and Jason Weaver, and commentary from Mark Johnson.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Lingo
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E3 Rotherham housemates Craig and Steve, married couple Angela and Mike from Bridgend, and sisters Laura and Mollie from Leeds use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leaving with nothing. Hosted by Adil Ray.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E7 Ben Shephard asks the questions as Harry Judd, Patrick Grant and Angela Barnes answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: S11 E82 24/10/2026 - 2 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
itv1anglia.uk.description: 24/12/2025 Bradley Walsh presents a fancy dress special, with comedian Lucy Porter, Countdown host Colin Murray, Strictly Come Dancing vocalist Tommy Blaize, and actor and comedian Asim Chaudhry, who will be taking on five Chasers. But what have the dreaded opponents come to the party dressed as this year.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Win Win
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E5 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Voice UK
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2026 E9 Emma Willis presents the semi-final of the singing contest, with the remaining acts competing for a place in the final. Coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, and Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones can pick only one from each of their teams to progress to the climax of the competition.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: E84 24/10/2026 - 3 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E2 Mel B and her daughter Phoenix, Jonathan Ross and his daughter Honey, and Richard Madeley and his daughter Chloe compete in the comedy game show where success lies in the hands of the parents. Mel's faith in Phoenix is brought into question, Jonathan has an outrageous idea for how Honey can turn an impediment into an advantage, and Chloe shares her dad's tendency to expose himself in the Madeley kitchen. Romesh also teaches his mum Shanthi how to deliver bad news to a Spice Girl.

itv1anglia.uk.title: English Football League Highlights : 24/10/2026
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E14 Action from the latest matches, including Lincoln City v Burnley at ProAmpac Stadium, West Ham United v Southampton at London Stadium, and Wolverhampton Wanderers v Watford at Molineux in the Championship.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E9 Sligo Town Dermot O'Leary visits Sligo, heading out into the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters to get his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch. In Sligo town, chef Anthony Gray leads him through treasured food institutions Clarke's, a family butcher, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store, and then cooks up a proudly Irish surf and turf.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E3 The Dinner Party Clodagh McKenna shares her strategy for throwing a perfect fuss-free dinner party, beginning with shortcut cacio e pepe cheese straws to welcome the guests. There is a quick and impressive French classic chicken fricassée for the main course, a make-ahead pistachio tiramisu for dessert and fresh mint tea to end the evening. Her blueprint includes a stunning table setting where the trick is keeping things simple.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E3 Liz and Kelvin discover that some farming questions are a lot harder to answer than others when Milo gets inquisitive about artificially inseminating the pigs. The farmhouse clear-out begins in earnest as plans are in for the renovation works, while with the Royal Cheshire Country Show looming, Marnie takes on the challenge of halter-training orphan lamb Hope.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 Northern Ireland (30min) James samples the culinary delights of Northern Ireland with friend and fellow chef Paul Rankin, visiting a wasabi farm, a rarity outside Japan. The day comes to an end with a trip to Lough Neagh, where Paul takes to the skies in a microlight and James goes eel fishing with some of the locals.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E32 James cooks lamb and turbot for actor Richard Armitage, currently starring in ITV1 crime drama Winter. Plus, recipes from chefs Atul Kochhar, John Hooker and Mark Birchall.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E3 BBQ Week Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as reality star Joey Essex, singer and TV presenter JB Gill and actress Lesley Joseph go head-to-head in a three-way cooking battle. With the help of their mentors, they have to produce delicious barbecue dishes using indoor grills, with two of the stars facing the cook-off, after which one will leave the competition.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News
itv1anglia.uk.description: E82 25/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E27 Actors Samuel West and Rishi Nair and Clarkson's Farm's Harriet Cowan join Alan. Elsewhere, there is the launch of a new wildlife garden project, and farmer Karl Franklin shows off his sheep-herding skills. Plus, a catch up with the East Sussex Wildlife Rescue Ambulance Service as they prepare to release herring gulls back into the wild, and lager is the order of the day in today's Best of British.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itv1anglia.uk.description: S5 E4 It is a busy time on the farm as the family prepares pigs for the butcher, ready to become sausages for their stall at the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz's plans are interrupted when she discovers an injured hen and takes the bird to her friend Debbie, a chicken expert. With Liz away, Kelvin enjoys a day with the boys, who get stuck into farm life as they help feed the pigs and build a new chicken coop, but there's a bigger problem in the front field, where flooding has put planting on hold.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Talking Royals
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E3 A weekly round-up of royal news, with expert analysis from ITV News' royal editor Chris Ship and expert Lizzie Robinson, and guests.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV Racing Aintree : 25/10/2026 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
itv1anglia.uk.description: Oli Bell presents live coverage of racing from Aintree, Market Rasen and Galway. James visits top chef Frances Atkins' beautiful restaurant the Yorke Arms, where he enjoys her signature dish al fresco, in her unusual dining room the Onion. Brian tastes the delights of some Yorkshire charcuterie, and later they both take time out, where James brushes up his clay pigeon skills and Brian is challenged to some off-road driving. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvgranada.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Avery Island
itvgranada.uk.description: James continues with a trip to an island that's not actually an island. Avery Island is a large salt mound and the home of the chili peppers that are used to make Tabasco sauce. James meets the family who farm the peppers, make the sauce and run the Tabasco company, and he's even granted access to the pepper fields to cook two amazing dishes. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvgranada.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvgranada.uk.description: Mark Benton, Elizabeth Carling and Ted Lasso star Bill Fellows join Alan Titchmarsh. Elsewhere, it's been called the Sport of Kings - we're at the polo. Plus, Florist Simon Lycett creates a new centrepiece for our barn using seasonal blooms, and we have the perfect crisp and wine pairings in Best of British. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvgranada.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - The Dinner Party

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Poltergeist
amc.us.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings -- Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.us.title: Carrie
amc.us.description: High school can be tough for many teenagers, but for Carrie White (Chloë Grace Moretz), it's especially hellish. A shy and awkward teen being raised by a religious zealot (Julianne Moore), Carrie is frequently the target of bullies. But Carrie has a secret talent: She can make things move with her mind. One fateful night, an especially cruel prank at her senior prom pushes her over the edge, and Carrie unleashes her telekinetic powers on all who get in her way. (Horror) - 2013

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.title: Silver Bullet
amc.us.description: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: The Shining
amc.us.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

amc.us.title: Tales From the Crypt - Maniac at Large ᴺᵉʷ
amc.us.description: A librarian fears a serial killer; with Blythe Danner, Adam Ant, Clarence Williams III; director John Frankenheimer. (Horror, Fantasy, Drama, Comedy) - 1992-08-19

amc.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
amc.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

amc.us.title: Cujo
amc.us.description: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

amc.us.title: The Fly
amc.us.description: When scientist Seth Brundle completes his teleportation device, he decides to test its abilities on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a housefly slips in during the process, leading to a merger of man and insect. Initially, Brundle appears to have undergone a successful teleportation, but the fly's cells begin to take over his body. As he becomes increasingly fly-like, Brundle's girlfriend is horrified as the person she once loved deteriorates into a monster. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1986

amc.us.title: Fright Night
amc.us.description: Teenage Charley Brewster is a horror-film junkie, so it's no surprise that when a reclusive new neighbor moves next-door, Brewster becomes convinced he's a vampire. It's also no surprise when nobody believes him. After strange events begin to occur, Charlie has no choice but to turn to the only person who could possibly help: washed-up television vampire killer Peter Vincent. (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

amc.us.title: The Lost Boys
amc.us.description: Teenage brothers Michael (Jason Patric) and Sam (Corey Haim) move with their mother (Dianne Wiest) to a small town in northern California. While the younger Sam meets a pair of kindred spirits in geeky comic-book nerds Edward (Corey Feldman) and Alan (Jamison Newlander), the angst-ridden Michael soon falls for Star (Jami Gertz) -- who turns out to be in thrall to David (Kiefer Sutherland), leader of a local gang of vampires. Sam and his new friends must save Michael and Star from the undead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1987

amc.us.title: Christine
amc.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

mlbnetwork.us.title: MLB Central
mlbnetwork.us.description: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball) - 2015-04-06

mlbnetwork.us.title: MLB Now ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

mlbnetwork.us.title: Intentional Talk ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - The Chupacabra Firebird
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's friend Porkchop wants to turn a '69 Firebird convertible into a tribute Trans Am for his wife; Shorty and his team transform the car with a new spoiler, motor mods with AC and fuel injection, custom interior and custom racing stripes. (Auto) - 2023-11-01

motortrend.us.description: Exploring the effects of different sized water tanks and their ability to keep the intake charge colder longer; air-to-water intercoolers make power by absorbing the heat of the intake air into the cool of the IC's water. (Auto) - 2023-04-07

motortrend.us.title: My Classic Car - Lincoln Continentals
motortrend.us.description: My Classic Car captures America's love affair with the automobile! Dennis Gage, the handlebar mustachioed host, takes you along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive. (Auto) - 2026-04-25

motortrend.us.title: Orange County Choppers Original - Memory Loss
motortrend.us.description: Paul Sr. and the OCC crew head over to the University of South Florida to get schooled on the effects of Alzheimer's, and possibly get his head checked. They also spend an evening over at the OCC Roadhouse competing for top dog at Bandingo's trivia night. (Reality) - 2026-03-14

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Laid-Out Dually and Amber Glow Hemi
motortrend.us.description: An Amber Glow 1955 DeSoto might be pink, but it has a hemi under the hood; 2000 Chevy dually is a monster, but needs a new paint job, interior and air ride system. (Auto) - 2023-11-22

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Finishing the Ember Glow Hemi
motortrend.us.description: Shorty tries to match the Ember Glow hemi's original color, then works his magic in the paint booth; Joel tries to figure out how to install an aftermarket AC; PG works on the interior; the crew is left with an enormous amount of trim. (Auto) - 2023-11-29

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - FJ45 Finishing Touches
motortrend.us.description: Ian tackles some of the design issues on his FJ45 project, making the necessary changes to get the build back on track. With a redesigned exhaust system and upgraded brakes, the FJ45 is ready to start moving forward again. (Reality) - 2026-09-12

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 3 ᴺᵉʷ
motortrend.us.description: After coming down from Top of the World, the team takes on one of Moab's most iconic trails, Hell's Revenge. With dramatic drop-offs, steep climbs and the infamous Hell's Gate, this trail puts both the rigs and drivers to the ultimate test. (Reality) - 2026-10-24

motortrend.us.title: Truck U - GMC Fanatic
motortrend.us.description: The owner of these two trucks loves the GMC brand. We get his newest project, a 1946 pickup, moving with an LS swap, while the daily driver OBS GMC gets outfitted with a new A/C system, so his drives are a little more comfortable. (Auto, How-to) - 2026-06-28

motortrend.us.title: Two Guys Garage - Cars for Christmas, Part 2
motortrend.us.description: The work continues at Willie's shop as more families' lives are changed by receiving a car for Christmas; Kevin Byrd joins Willie for the builds, bringing his expertise and passion to the cause. (Auto, Reality) - 2026-10-18

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Driving Miss Crazy
motortrend.us.description: The first of the Three Amigos builds is coming to a close -- a 1970 tribute Barracuda with a 392 crate Hemi! Mark and the team rush to complete the dash, the 392 Hemi, the A/C and the interior for the Barracuda's first road test in over 7 years. (Reality, Auto, How-to) - 2025-07-22

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - High Impacts and Low Blows
motortrend.us.description: Mark demonstrates two different types of car collision, highlighting the often-overlooked secondary damage; Alyssa assists Doug with a particular rear axle. (Reality, Auto, How-to)

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Could It Bee a 383?
motortrend.us.description: Mark needs Tony's help to solve a Mopar mystery; will the evidence give Mark the certainty he requires? When John from Phillips Racecraft arrives, the fate of Doug's nasty 440 engine is revealed. (Reality, Auto, How-to, Entertainment) - 2025-08-06

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Mark Unmuted
motortrend.us.description: Mark Worman and his gang of garage ghouls work to bring some of the most wrecked muscle cars back to life. (Reality, Auto, How-to, Entertainment) - 2025-08-16

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Mopar by Death
motortrend.us.description: Mark airs the entire "Mopar by Death" animated series! (Reality, Auto, How-to)

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - This ZZ1 is Tops!

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - A Tale of Two Drop Tops
motortrend.us.description: Mark and Aaron show off two related and rare builds; digging into the Graveyard Carz archives, for the first time ever, they squeeze two complete car builds into one episode, a 1967 Hemi GTX convertible and a 1969 Hemi Road Runner convertible.

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Even White Carz Get the Blues
motortrend.us.description: A decade-long restoration comes full circle. This rare, two-tone, Hemi 'Cuda is finally complete and ready to go home, but not before Mark shows us why the Hemi is the King-Kong of the street!

motortrend.us.title: Graveyard Carz - Mopars of Screen and Strip

motortrend.us.description: Shorty's right-hand man in the body shop, Joe Gomez, has been in remission from cancer for nearly 10 years and wants to create a wide body Honda Accord for his wife to show his appreciation.

motortrend.us.title: Engine Masters - The Throttle-Body Throwdown!
motortrend.us.description: The crew compares 90 mm and 105 mm forward-facing throttle bodies against one another, and then to 2000 cfm worth of top-mounted, dual quad-style throttle bodies, all atop a fuel-injected, 700-hp LS7.

motortrend.us.title: Motorhead Garage - Engrave Your Future and See How Additives Are Built ᴺᵉʷ

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Caleb's Corvette Part 2

motortrend.us.title: Two Guys Garage - Young Guns Part 2

motortrend.us.title: Two Guys Garage - The Ultimate Swap-Off: LS3 vs. Godzilla
motortrend.us.description: Willie B and Kevin Byrd double down on Ford's favorite pony car with a Mustang-centric build-off where stock isn't in the vocabulary. The Fox body notchback gets an LS engine swapped in, and the Mustang fastback gets a 7.3 Godzilla swap.

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Ford vs. Shorty: The Texas Torino

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

Shortly thereafter, Brennan dies and Katherine miscarries when Damien pushes her off a balcony. 400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama, and ruthlessly murdered the employees. Unbeknownst to the killers, a secret video surveillance camera recorded the shooting. Local police and the FBI released images of the crime to the media, and were quickly able to identify the perpetrators. Now authorities had to find two cold-blooded killers who knew that they were being pursued for murder one.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Lincoln County, Nebraska, a fugitive drug dealer engaged in a shootout with state troopers, wounding two of them, and eluded capture after a high-speed chase. Authorities immediately set up a statewide manhunt, connecting the fugitive to a murder in western Nebraska. A chance sighting led FBI agents to a second confrontation with the killer, who was more determined than ever to escape the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions. They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits. Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest. After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist. By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train. The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him. As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

actionmax.us.title: Nerve
actionmax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

(Adventure, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

(Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: MacGruber
cinemax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Meg
cinemax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Rampage
cinemax.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cinemax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Beirut
cinemax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Epic
cinemax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Shazam!
cinemax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
cinemax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Black Adam
cinemax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

cinemax.us.title: The Flash
cinemax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: The Art of Getting By

He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

cinemaxaction.us.title: Nerve
cinemaxaction.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2016-07-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
cinemaxaction.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1986-12-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Men
cinemaxaction.us.description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. (Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2022-05-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Nun II
cinemaxaction.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
cinemaxaction.us.description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2017-09-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, LGBTQ, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-07-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: Papillon
cinemaxaction.us.description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld who is framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an unlikely alliance with convicted counterfeiter Louis Dega, who in exchange for protection, agrees to finance Papillon's escape. (Adventure, Biography, Crime, Drama, Historical drama) - 2017-09-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemaxaction.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical drama, History) - 2010-05-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Patti Cake$
cinemaxaction.us.description: Fed up with life in her New Jersey hometown, Patricia Dombrowski, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to follow in the footsteps of her idol and hit the road to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a mysterious musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back. (Drama, Hip-Hop & Rap, Movie, Music) - 2017-01-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemaxaction.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy, Movie) - 2013-12-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2010-05-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Perfect Match
cinemaxaction.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Comedy, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2016-03-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Room
cinemaxaction.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-09-04

cinemaxaction.us.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Comedy) - 2021-08-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam
cinemaxaction.us.description: Swackhammer (Danny DeVito), an evil alien theme park owner, needs a new attraction at Moron Mountain. When his gang, the Nerdlucks, heads to Earth to kidnap Bugs Bunny (Billy West) and the Looney Tunes, Bugs challenges them to a basketball game to determine their fate. The aliens agree, but they steal the powers of NBA basketball players, including Larry Bird (Larry Bird) and Charles Barkley (Charles Barkley) -- so Bugs gets some help from superstar Michael Jordan (Michael Jordan). (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Comedy, Family) - 1996-11-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
cinemaxaction.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2021-07-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2011-06-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Rampage
cinemaxaction.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2018-04-12

cinemaxaction.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemaxaction.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (Biography, Drama, Movie, War) - 2017-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemaxaction.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Movie, Mystery) - 2012-11-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Fantastic Planet
cinemaxaction.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Animation, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1973-05-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hobbit
cinemaxaction.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Family, Fantasy) - 1977-11-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Time Bandits
cinemaxaction.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Adventure, Comedy, Family, Fantasy, Movie) - 1981-11-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxaction.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 1989

cinemaxaction.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Lara Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 1992-05-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Art of Getting By
cinemaxaction.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2011-01-23

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Despicable Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy) - 2010-07-09

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ricochet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action, Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1991

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Country, Drama, Folk, Gospel) - 2005-11-18

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. ifc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
ifc.us.description: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all. (Horror) - 1987

ifc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
ifc.us.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late? (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on. (Horror) - 1985

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Thrills & Spills
history.ca.description: Remember when people would do just about anything for an adrenaline fix? From racing cars at the "Murderdrome," to high diving on horseback, to cutting our teeth on looping water slides, revisit the ways people once chased a thrill. These death-defying stunts and gravity-pushing spectacles didn't always stick the landing, but that didn't stop anyone from trying. It's a heart-pumping jolt back to a time when a big rush was worth a little spill. (Documentary, Reality) - 2026-05-31

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Twisted Toys
history.ca.description: Remember when playtime meant tempting fate?; from toy belts that fire speeding projectiles, to high-powered pogo sticks that send people soaring, to dolls that try to eat people alive, these playthings are made for kids, but their risks are anything but child's play; it's a mind-blowing, bone-rattling trip through the toys of yesteryear that remind people of a time when childhood was wild, free, and hazardous. (Documentary, Reality) - 2026-05-03

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Hell On Wheels
history.ca.description: Remember when hitting the road meant flirting with disaster?; from rumble seats that turn passengers into projectiles, to scorching cigarette lighters built right into the dash, to cars that have a habit of going up in flames, even a simple trip can go south; these are the bright ideas and questionable designs that turn people daily commute into a demolition derby; it's a high-speed, white-knuckle ride back to a time when the rules of the road were still being written. (Documentary, Reality) - 2026-05-10

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Fatal Attractions
history.ca.description: Remember when popular tourist attractions came with real danger? From climbing onto the backs of live alligators, to hand-feeding hungry bears, to scoring front-row seats to atomic blasts, these heart-pounding experiences promised irresistible thrills you'd never forget - where the risk was part of the draw; it's a jaw-dropping, pulse-racing trip back to the places that prove our hazardous history wasn't just entertaining - it was a death-defying must-see! (Documentary) - 2026-06-14

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Crowd Chaos
history.ca.description: Remember when being part of the crowd meant taking your chances? From packing in shoulder to shoulder for front row views of Civil War battles, to lining up to watch dead whales explode, to full-blown riots while shopping, the biggest shared moments didn't just bring people together - they stirred things up; it's a wild, edge-of-your-seat trip back to the gatherings that prove our hazardous history was anything but orderly - but always had an eager audience! (Documentary) - 2026-06-21

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Very Extreme Sports
history.ca.description: The modern concept of extreme sports is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the lack of rules made them truly extreme; from bone-crushing football and deadly baseball games to wild events like auto polo. (Documentary) - 2025-07-06

From packing in shoulder to shoulder for front row views of Civil War battles, to lining up to watch dead whales explode, to full-blown riots while shopping, the biggest shared moments didn't just bring people together - they stirred things up; it's a wild, edge-of-your-seat trip back to the gatherings that prove our hazardous history was anything but orderly - but always had an eager audience! (Documentary) - 2026-06-21

history.ca.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Young & the Reckless
history.ca.description: When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive; from launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go—and the consequences that came with it; armed with cherry bombs, slingshots and more confidence than caution, we pushed boundaries in ways that would make parents today shudder. (Documentary, Reality) - 2026-07-05

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren - Change Agents
history.ca.description: Every once in a while, it's not the weapons and wars that redraw a new world order, but the ideas and inventions; with Dolph Lundgren leading the charge, witnessing the printing press that toppled kings, the Apple II computer dreamed up in a garage and the iconic Model T that put the world on wheels; these revolutionary machines didn't just reshape history, they created it. (Documentary) - 2026-07-20

history.ca.title: History's Greatest Mysteries - Percy Fawcett and the Lost City of Z
history.ca.description: Percy Fawcett becomes obsessed with a lost city deep in the Amazon jungle, a place he names the City of Z; Fawcett vanishes trying to locate it despite numerous missions to find him. (History, Documentary, Mystery) - 2025-07-21

history.ca.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd - Man vs. Nature
history.ca.description: Mother Nature doesn't always play nice, whether it's a mile-long sinkhole, a biblical swarm of crop-killing grasshoppers or an invasion of rum-fueled monkeys running wild on the island of St. Kitts; stories where humans go head-to-head with nature. (Documentary, History, Anthology) - 2025-12-05

history.ca.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny - Dark Deals
history.ca.description: Some deals are made to announce headlines, while others are steered in the shadows; when the CIA wants to take out the Iraqi Prime Minister, they turn to a 20-year-old law student named Saddam Hussein, while in Guatemala, a banana company colludes with the CIA to topple the country's leader to protect its profits; decades later in Ukraine, a top-secret unit of CIA operatives thwarts Russia's invasion plans, before the world even knows the battle has begun. (Documentary) - 2026-07-16

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: A new boy band tries to steal the spotlight in 'We're the Chipmunks', then in 'Save the Dance', the Principal gives Alvin & Derek an ultimatum - if they fight, the dance will be cancelled. (S2, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin gets a device that let's him listen in on everyone's conversations in 'iHear', and in 'Switch Witch', the Halloween candy disappears and perhaps the culprit is the Switch Witch. (S2, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks and Chipettes play in a dodgeball tournament in 'Munk Vs Machine', then in 'Shack Magic', The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic? (S4, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: A local haunted house doesn't seem too scary in 'Time Traveller's Party', then in 'Return of Thornbergaupht', Derek bullies Simon by not allowing him to use the boys' bathroom. (S5, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard. (S1, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending in 'Munk Man', and in 'Ride Along', when Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest in 'The Gift', and then in 'Theo Knows Best', when Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has ideas on how the money should be spent. (S3, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin talks Dave into a poor scheme in 'Tour Bus', then in 'Game Show', Alvin signs the Chipmunks up for a game show that forces losing contestants to perform dangerous stunts. (S4, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep in 'Dr. Sleep', then in 'Davey Boy', Alvin zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen. (S5, ep 6)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is. (S2, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety in 'The Karate Kidder', then in 'Playing Favourites', Alvin and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race. (S3, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Candy Confessions: Grounded once again, Alvin begs Theodore to buy him the limited edition skateboard he's always wanted. But, Theodore gets sidetracked by his sweet tooth! (S1, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: No Putts, No Glory: Alvin tricks Theodore into believing he's great at mini golf which backfires when Theo signs up for a tournament. (S4, ep 10b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dog Days: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but have to keep the puppy hidden from Dave, who won't allow pets. (S2, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Bathroom Bully: When Miss Smith praises Simon's grades in class, Derek bullies him by not allowing him to use the boys' bathroom. (S5, ep 9b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipettes fall in love with a cute little mouse in 'Of Mice and Munks', and in 'Simon Saves the World', Simon's new invention creates a time loop and changing gravity inside the house. (S4, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Eleanor train to be lifeguards in 'The Lifeguard', then in 'Scarecrowner', Miss Croner's prized cherries go missing, and she suspects crows - but could it be chipmunks? (S5, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a 30-foot giant in 'Theozilla', then in 'Doggone It', all the phones at school are missing, and Alvin is blamed. (S1, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore struggles to do good deeds in 'Knights', and then in 'Snake Charmer', Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes. (S2, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore's teddy bear gets bear-napped in 'Switcheroo', and in 'The Paperboy', when Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay. (S3, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero. (S4, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theo's art project gains fans but then gets hacked in 'Mr. Lou', then in 'Love Song', Simon panics when Dave's song reveals his poem. (S5, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks get stuck in traffic in 'Car Wars', then in 'Mr. Fix-It', Simon gets annoyed with everyone asking him to fix things so he decides to play dumb until he gets some thanks. (S5, ep 17)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest in 'Skater Girl', then in 'All Washed Up', Simon's robot Geizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines, but is he actually helping? (S5, ep 15)
