shoxbetwest.us.title: Noah's Arc: Jumping the Broom
shoxbetwest.us.description: Gay couple Noah (Darryl Stephens) and Wade (Jensen Atwood) invite their friends along for a weekend of revelry when they decide to get married in Martha's Vineyard. - 2008

shoxbetwest.us.title: Aurora: A Love Story
shoxbetwest.us.description: Kenny and Giselle are set to marry on a beach in Puerto Rico. Giselle disappears on the day of the ceremony, setting off a wild chain of events that unearths secrets, lies and betrayal, and threatens to destroy the fairy-tale love story. - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: Passion Play: Russell Westbrook
shoxbetwest.us.description: Rare footage and extensive interviews provide insight into the dynamic life and career of NBA player Russell Westbrook.

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Resurgence: DeMarcus Cousins
shoxbetwest.us.description: A documentary following DeMarcus Cousins while he recovers from an injury that has been a career death sentence for some NBA players; featuring exclusive interviews with teammates, coaches and NBA insiders.

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour
shoxbetwest.us.description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat. - 1998

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 2
shoxbetwest.us.description: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy. - 2001

shoxbetwest.us.title: Rush Hour 3
shoxbetwest.us.description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. - 2007

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Marathon Man
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War) - 1976

showtimeshowcase.us.title: We Were Soldiers
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. (Drama) - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction. (War, Drama) - 1979

showtimeshowcase.us.title: V for Vengeance
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After learning that their younger sibling escaped an earlier kidnapping attempt that also killed their parents, two estranged sisters must join forces to rescue her from a group of bloodthirsty vampires. Out for revenge and control of a vampirism vaccine, Thorn and his band of the undead soon learn that they messed with the wrong family. (Horror, Action) - 2022

showtimeshowcase.us.title: We Were Soldiers
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Changing Lanes
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2016

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shutter Island
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Gangs of New York
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. (Historical drama, Crime drama) - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Stepford Wives
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2004

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Best in Show
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. (Comedy, LGBTQ) - 2000

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Old Guy
showtimeshowcase.us.description: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Old School
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity. - 2003

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers. - 2011

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Horrible Bosses 2
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After a shady investor steals their new invention, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) conspire to kidnap the man's adult son and ransom him to pay off their debts. - 2014

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Jackass: The Movie
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Nitwits (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Chris Pontius) perform outrageous stunts and pull practical jokes on an unsuspecting public. - 2002

showtimeshowcase.us.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.). - 2016

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Perfect Gamble
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimeshowcase.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - 2022

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Winchester
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Ensconced in her sprawling San Jose, California mansion, eccentric firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle. - 2018

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sweetness
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When a fan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. - 2025

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Hostage
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint. - 2005

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Venom
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Resurrected as a killer, a gas station owner terrorizes a group of teenagers (Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey) in the swamps of Louisiana. - 2005

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Cured
showtimeextreme.us.description: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. (Horror, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimeextreme.us.description: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Wild Wild West
showtimeextreme.us.description: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction) - 1999

showtimeextreme.us.title: Get Hard
showtimeextreme.us.description: When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other. (Comedy) - 2015

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Equalizer 2
showtimeextreme.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. (Action, Thriller) - 2018

showtimeextreme.us.title: Blade Runner 2049
showtimeextreme.us.description: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Yards
showtimeextreme.us.description: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. (Crime drama) - 2000

showtimeextreme.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
showtimeextreme.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1996

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
showtimeextreme.us.description: Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions. (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 1996

showtimeextreme.us.title: Along Came a Spider
showtimeextreme.us.description: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2001

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Saint
showtimeextreme.us.description: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. (Action) - 1997

showtimeextreme.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
showtimeextreme.us.description: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer. (Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2007

showtimeextreme.us.title: Hostage
showtimeextreme.us.description: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family. (Action, Thriller) - 2005

showtimeextreme.us.title: Argo
showtimeextreme.us.description: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Grizzly Night
showtimeextreme.us.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. (Drama) - 2025

showtimeextreme.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtimeextreme.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. - 2024

showtimeextreme.us.title: Troy
showtimeextreme.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy. - 2004

showtimeextreme.us.title: Colossal
showtimeextreme.us.description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world. - 2016

showtimeextreme.us.title: Tale of the Mummy
showtimeextreme.us.description: A woman (Louise Lombard) investigates the mysterious disappearance of her grandfather at the tomb of an Egyptian prince 50 years earlier. - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: Machete Kills
showtimeextreme.us.description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world. - 2013

showtimeextreme.us.title: Paycheck
showtimeextreme.us.description: After learning that his memory has been erased, a technical wizard (Ben Affleck) goes on the run to piece together clues from his past. - 2003

showtimeextreme.us.title: Congo
showtimeextreme.us.description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa. - 1995

showtimeextreme.us.title: Million Dollar Baby
showtimeextreme.us.description: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing. - 2004

showtimeextreme.us.title: Gravity
showtimeextreme.us.description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue. - 2013

showtimeextreme.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - 2019

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cimarron
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1889, adventurous lawyer and newspaper editor Yancey Cravat (Richard Dix) convinces his genteel wife, Sabra (Irene Dunne), to join him in the rush to populate Osage, Oklahoma. After they begin to settle into the community, Yancey leaves to go further west. Alone, Sabra inherits his editorial duties and struggles to bring civilization to the rough frontier town. Over a tumultuous 40 years, the couple are repeatedly separated and reunited as Oklahoma makes its long journey to statehood. (Western) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ghost Valley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A crooked judge (Mitchell Harris) unwittingly hires the heir to a gold mine to scare his cousin (Merna Kennedy) into selling the property. (Western, Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Annie Oakley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Expert markswoman Annie Oakley (Barbara Stanwyck) leaves her backwoods home to challenge New York's vaudeville sharpshooter, Toby Walker (Preston Foster). Toby is skeptical of Annie's skill, but although she purposely loses their contest, the business partner of Buffalo Bill Cody (Moroni Olsen) realizes her potential. Cody builds an act for his Wild West show around Annie and Toby's rivalry, but it is threatened by their acquaintance with native Chief Sitting Bull, and a challenge for Toby. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Scarlet River
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An actor (Tom Keene) on the set of a cowboy movie rescues a rancher (Dorothy Wilson) from her foreman (Creighton Chaney). (Western) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Carl Laemmle
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The extraordinary life story of Carl Laemmle, the German-Jewish immigrant who founded Universal Pictures and saved over 300 Jewish families from Nazi Germany. (Documentary) - 2019

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Frankenstein
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation. (Horror) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Invisible Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him. (Science fiction) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Black Cat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor. (Horror) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Posing for a portrait, Dorian Gray (Hurd Hatfield) talks with Lord Henry Wotton (George Sanders), who says that men should pursue their sensual longings, but laments that only the young get to do so. Taken with the idea, Dorian imagines a scenario in which the painting will age as he stays youthful. His wish comes true, and his boyish looks aid him as he indulges his every whim. But when a stunning revelation forces him to see what he's become, Dorian faces some very dangerous questions. (Horror) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Beast With Five Fingers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Astrologist Hilary Cummins (Peter Lorre) works as a personal assistant to the eccentric and mostly paralyzed pianist, Francis Ingram (Victor Francen). A nurse, Julie Holden (Andrea King) also lives at the Italian villa to help care for Ingram, who plays the piano with only his undamaged left hand. Following a visit from a scam artist (Robert Alda), Ingram crashes down the stairs to his death -- and a plague of bizarre events ensues that are attributed to the musician's disembodied left hand. (Horror) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Science fiction) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Science fiction) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Lost City - The Tunnel of Flame
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes. (Drama, Adventure)

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Gillespie's Criminal Case
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Leonard Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) presses prison officials about one of his former patients, convicted murderer Roy Todwell (John Craven), trying to convince them that Todwell is dangerously insane and should be committed to a mental hospital. Meanwhile, rival doctors Randall Red Adams (Van Johnson) and Lee Wong How (Keye Luke) attempt to convince embittered veteran Alvin Peterson (William Lundigan) to accept and overcome the disability he received in the attack on Pearl Harbor. (Drama) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - The Case of the Stuttering Pig
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A monster targets Porky and his family for their inheritance. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1937-10-30

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Looney Tunes - Claws for Alarm
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Porky and Sylvester stay the night in a big scary mansion. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1954-05-22

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Golden Eighties
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Three women, Lili, Mado and Pascale, compete for Robby's attention until he suddenly proposes to Mado. As the wedding date arrives, Lili tries one more time for Robby's affections. (Comedy) - 1986

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sapphire
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A pregnant college student named Sapphire Robbins (Yvonne Buckingham) is murdered in London's Hampstead Heath. When police superintendent Robert Hazard (Nigel Patrick) discovers that the victim was a light-skinned black woman passing as white, it upends his initial assumptions. Hazard and his openly racist assistant (Michael Craig) explore the city's racially tense underground jazz scene as they interview suspects, including Sapphire's white fiancé (Paul Massie). (Mystery) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Candidate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Without a candidate to run for the senate seat against admired Republican Crocker Jarmon (Don Porter), campaign manager Marvin Lucas (Peter Boyle) recruits leftist lawyer Bill McKay (Robert Redford). McKay's appearance piques the public's interest, and gradually Lucas pushes McKay toward a more centrist message. As McKay's original and honest platform gets watered down, his popularity increases so much that he is running even with Jarmon as Election Day approaches. (Comedy drama) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: American Graffiti
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the last day of summer vacation in 1962, friends Curt (Richard Dreyfuss), Steve (Ronny Howard), Terry (Charles Martin Smith) and John (Paul Le Mat) cruise the streets of small-town California while a mysterious disc jockey (Wolfman Jack) spins classic rock'n'roll tunes. It's the last night before their grown-up lives begin, and Steve's high-school sweetheart, a hot-to-trot blonde, a bratty adolescent and a disappearing angel in a Thunderbird provide all the excitement they can handle. (Comedy drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sullivan's Travels
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Hollywood director's desire to produce a film about real people and human suffering leads him on an odyssey as a hobo. - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Contempt
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A screenwriter's wife (Brigitte Bardot) becomes angry with her husband when he fails to defend her honor after a producer (Jack Palance) makes a pass at her. - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The House on Telegraph Hill

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Over the Edge
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Bored teens (Michael Kramer, Pamela Ludwig, Matt Dillon) turn to sex, booze and violence in their plotted suburban community. - 1979

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Running on Empty
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two former '60s radicals (Christine Lahti, Judd Hirsch) live underground with their sons, one of whom (River Phoenix) wants to stop running. - 1988

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Red Shadow
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Gen. Bierbeau sends his weakling son, Pierre, to French Morocco to fight Arab insurgents in hopes of toughening him up. - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sylvia and the Phantom
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sylvie falls in love with a figure from the lore of her family's castle, so her father hires three actors to impersonate the ghost of her beloved. - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Canterville Ghost
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A GI (Robert Young) billets in a relative's (Margaret O'Brien) castle, haunted by a cowardly 300-year-old ghost (Charles Laughton). - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The House on Telegraph Hill

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: All Fall Down
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young man (Brandon de Wilde) is disgusted by his older brother's (Warren Beatty) treatment of a woman (Eva Marie Saint). - 1962

BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E7 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 3 The Doctor has captured a Tyrannosaurus Rex but the conspirators don’t intend for it to remain captive for long. Sarah follows a lead but places herself in the hands of the enemy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E8 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 4 Sarah awakens to discover that she is on a spaceship that left Earth months ago and is heading for a new world. The Doctor is framed for causing the return of the dinosaurs.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E9 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 5 Sarah discovers that the spaceship passengers are all victims of a deception, but not all are willing to believe her story.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E10 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 6 Dinosaurs are appearing all over London in a last effort to frighten people away as Professor Whitaker prepares to initiated ‘Operation Golden Age’.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E11 Death to the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS suffers a power drain and is forced down on the planet Exxilon. Sarah is captured by the primitive inhabitants and the Doctor comes face to face with his oldest enemies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E12 Death to the Daleks: Part 2 The Daleks weaponry is rendered useless by the power drain and they are forced to make a truce with the Doctor and the members of the expedition from Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E13 Death to the Daleks: Part 3 The Daleks force the Exillons to work as slave labour to mine the life saving parrinium. The Doctor and Bellal brave the puzzles and traps of the Exxilon city.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E14 Death to the Daleks: Part 4 The Doctor and Bellal arrive at the centre of the Exxilon city but the Daleks are preparing to depart and launch a deadly plague missile that will kill everyone left behind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E15 The Monster of Peladon: Part 1 The Doctor makes a return visit to Peladon some years after his previous visit. There he discovers that several miners have died and the ghost of Aggedor is to blame.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E16 The Monster of Peladon: Part 2 Chancellor Ortron accuses the Doctor and Sarah of being in league with the rebel miners and sentences them to be punished by Aggedor himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E17 The Monster of Peladon: Part 3 Desperate to avoid a revolt from the miners, the Doctor attempts to expose the fraud of Aggedor’s ghost. Alpha Centauri has summoned Federation troops, but whose side are they on?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E18 The Monster of Peladon: Part 4 The Ice Warriors have taken control of Peladon. Pretending to cooperate, the Doctor concocts a plan to defeat the invaders.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E11 Dolly Plum Daisy and Poppy turn Nanny Plum into a doll and soon the fairy toy becomes very popular - everyone wants one!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E3 The Rustler Roundup Kai helps Bell track down stolen nerfs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E29 Night Ninja's School Of Naughtiness Night Ninja sets up a school for villains.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E14 Missing Lake When Tracker falls into sinkhole, he meets several creatures in the underground tunnels that need rescuing. But while waiting for Ryla's assistance, he's forced to take the lead to keep the animals safe from the rising water.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S25 E32 The Super-Long Shortcut When Gordon is unable to make an important delivery on his own, Thomas offers his help, but Gordon insists on second-guessing Thomas's every move.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E30 100 Ways to Leave the Planet It's time for the biggest adventure of all - there's a whole universe to explore. Get ready to be a number explorer with everything you've learned from the Numberblocks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Follow That Car When Petunia's new self-driving mail van takes off without her, there's only one animal that can go fast enough to catch it!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fantus And The Animals
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 Fantus and the Ducks Fantus meets two ducks who are going to a pond. They splash in the water and go up on land to dry.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Mr Dinosaur is Lost Mr Dinosaur is George's favourite toy. When Mr Dinosaur goes missing, George is distraught. Daddy Pig helps Peppa to become a detective and together they track down Mr Dinosaur - making George a very happy little piggy again.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E16 The Air Orchestra The Wiggles are getting ready for Wiggle Town's first air musician band competition! Captain plays the air trumpet, Lachy the air piano, and Caterina, the air flute. What other instruments will they play?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E14 Missing Piece Shaun comes across a discarded jigsaw puzzle and calls on the Flock to help him put it together. When Bitzer discovers the final piece is missing they decide they must do whatever it takes to solve the puzzle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Trick or TRACE-E When The Spidey Team is planning to stop Green Goblin, he manages to throw the heroes' plans off course.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 Not So Supertato Evil Pea tricks Supertato into believing that he has no superpowers without his red cape. When he rescues his friends without it, he discovers that he has superpowers - cape or no cape!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Great Yarn Caper / Get the Boot The SuperKitties must figure out why someone is stealing all the yarn in Kittydale. / Lab Rat invents a giant boot to smush all the flowers at the Kittydale Flower Festival.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 The Royal Golf School A mole disturbs King Thistle's Golf Course, so a Gnome is enlisted to help drive it away. Soon though the Gnome is ordering the Elves around, and turning the King's Golf Course into a Crazy Golf Course.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Earworm A mysterious song gets stuck in Flower and Flour's heads, and their quest to shake it reveals a special musical bond between Flower, Penny, and Por Por.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 King Cat Flower and her friends decide to make a movie starring Flour during the school holidays. While not as easy as it first seems, the challenges eventually prove to be part of the fun.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E34 Woodland Club Peppa and her friends are introduced to some simple woodcraft in the woods with Mr. Wolf.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E35 Danny's Pirate Bedroom Peppa helps Danny Dog with a bedroom make-over on the theme of pirates and sea monsters.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 The Weekend At the weekend, Bluey and Bingo are playing in the garden with Dad. But Bingo gets upset when she discovers a walking leaf insect and Dad is too caught up in the game to notice.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 BBQ It's lunchtime on Bluey's back deck! But every BBQ needs a side salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousin's asked for!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Sunday Roast It's the great 'Sunday Roast', the day when the Potatodons' hides are extra hot, crispy and delicious!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Pea Shooter The volcano is active which means the baby Pea-Rexes get to play Pea Shooter. Ginger manages to find her own way to join in.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zog
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Gadabout the Gardener Feeling unappreciated, Gadabout discovers a talent for gardening. Zog and Pearl discover his green fingers have upset the natural balance of the land, making others ill.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 The Balloon Badge Duggee blows up some balloons for Tino the artistic mouse's birthday, but the squirrels are worried because Tino can be grumpy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Frog Song It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a Ribbit Song and Enid turns anime, to chase after the mouse.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E11 Pools Splash! Fizzy and Suds follow the construction of a swimming pool from the factory to a backyard, explore swimming animals, and create creative terracotta bird baths.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E5 Sea And Space: 5 Zindzi and Rachael explore the deep blue sea as Kiya and Jemima discover an underwater volcano! Zindzi and Dr Karl make their own fun volcano experiment. Through The Windows we take a tour through the solar system!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piggy Builders ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E21 The Pig Chill It's the hottest day in Fine Forest! The Piggies build an ice machine for cold drinks - but Wilf, wanting it all, accidentally causes a blizzard!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 The Legend of Capitán Calavera When Santiago discovers the lost treasure of the legendary Capitain Calavera, he and his friends become the new Pirate Protectors of Isla Encanto.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E14 Run Daddy Run After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like! So, Peppa and George step in to help train him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Peppa Pig: Wedding Party! Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow surprise everyone with their wedding announcement and everyone rallies around to make it memorable!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Stick To It The Mechas find Pretty Big City in a sticky situation when the factory starts spewing super sticky slime everywhere!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Nikhil and Jay and the Turmeric Superpower Jay gets turmeric on his hands and turns everything yellow! What if the whole world turns yellow with his turmeric superpower?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Millie Magnificent
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E34 The Most Magnificent Underwater Adventure Millie and her friends try to recreate what they saw at their local aquarium for Norman, when they realize he's never seen real live fish before.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Stan & Gran
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Flight! Camera! Action! Grumblestunk's new speed camera catches Stan breaking the speed limit on his scooter, but he can't have been! Stan and Gran have to clear his name!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 A Touch Of Clouds Miffy and her friends wonder what clouds feel like. Soft? Fluffy? Bouncy? After attempting to catch one, they are no closer to knowing.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Cataversary When Pants finds mysterious gifts just for him, he searches everywhere for Mittens so he can share the news with his best friend. But where is she?!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Career Day It seems like all the animals in Kibble Corners are perfectly suited for their jobs, but Mittens isn't sure what kind of job she wants to do.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E4 This Little Piggy Join Anthony and Lucia in the Wiggly Kitchen, what will they find today? It's then time for some finger play fun with 'This Little Piggy' then the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town are here to help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

Hired to perform a covert hit, he is double-crossed and forced to go on the run. Machete may be down, but not out, and he carves a path of blood, bullets and broken hearts in his quest to settle the score. (Action) - 2010

fxm.us.description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza (Kirk Douglas) from his son, Robin (Andrew Stevens), the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress (John Cassavetes), who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian (Amy Irving), a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin. (Thriller, Horror) - 1978

fxm.us.title: Wee Willie Winkie
fxm.us.description: With her widowed mother (June Lang), precocious Priscilla (Shirley Temple) travels to India to live with her grandfather, Col. Williams (C. Aubrey Smith). A stern officer in the British army, the colonel makes it clear that a military garrison isn't any place for a child. Priscilla proves otherwise, befriending tenderhearted Sgt. MacDuff (Victor McLaglen), getting caught up in the plot of a rebel leader (Cesar Romero) and charming everyone in sight. (Comedy drama) - 1937

fxm.us.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
fxm.us.description: Defying her conventional in-laws, young widow Lucy Muir (Gene Tierney) leaves London with her young daughter and moves away for a quieter life in a secluded seaside cottage. Lucy discovers the ghost of the deceased former owner, sea captain Daniel Gregg (Rex Harrison), is haunting the house, but gathers the courage to stand up to him, and woman and ghost become friends. Faced with dwindling means of support, Lucy agrees to the Captain's challenge to write his colorful life story. (Fantasy) - 1947

fxm.us.title: Three Coins in the Fountain
fxm.us.description: Three hopeful American secretaries visiting Italy -- newcomer Maria (Maggie McNamara), romance-seeking Anita (Jean Peters) and the more mature Frances (Dorothy McGuire) -- fling their coins into Rome's Trevi Fountain, each making a wish. Soon, Maria is pursued by a dashing prince (Louis Jourdan), Anita finds herself involved with a forbidden coworker (Rossano Brazzi), and Frances receives a surprising proposal from her boss (Clifton Webb). All three women vow to one day return to Rome. (Romance) - 1954

fxm.us.title: Love Is a Many Splendored Thing
fxm.us.description: In Hong Kong in 1949, Mark Elliott is an American reporter covering the Chinese civil war. Undergoing a trial separation from his wife, he meets the beautiful Dr. Han Suyin, a widowed physician from mainland China. As the pair fall in love, they encounter disapproval from both her family and his friends about their interracial romance. Although the film was a commercial success upon release, the casting of Jones in an Asian role has since been criticized. (Romance) - 1955

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04
